Their hairstyle, glasses, smile, clothing preferences and family dynamic become part of an original composition. The finished artwork can suggest undercover partners, a sophisticated gala, a city-night mission or a cheerful family operation while still looking recognisably like the people you know.

Anime Cabinet portraits are drawn by human artists, not generated by an AI filter. That matters when you want small details handled thoughtfully: a child’s expression, a distinctive fringe, a favourite jacket, a dog’s personality or the way two people stand together. You receive a preview within 72 hours as standard, with unlimited free revisions so the gift feels right before you approve it.

sections.heading: What photos are needed for a Spy x Family inspired gift portrait?

blocks.text: For a custom anime portrait from photo, upload clear, well-lit images where each person’s face is visible. Front-facing or three-quarter photographs usually provide useful reference, but you can send more than one image if you want the artist to combine a favourite smile with a preferred hairstyle or outfit.

items: Use recent photos that show the person as they look now.
Avoid heavy filters, extreme shadows and faces hidden by sunglasses or hats unless those details are part of the requested design.
For group artwork, identify everyone from left to right and explain the desired arrangement.
Mention who should have a serious, cheerful or mischievous expression.
For pets, include a clear photo and note their breed, markings, size and typical demeanour.
Add outfit, background and occasion notes so the composition matches the gift.

blocks.text: You do not need professional photography. Ordinary phone photos work well when they show the key features clearly. If you are ordering secretly, choose reference images from different occasions and explain the surprise gift in the order notes.
